FAQ

AI chatbot development, explained.

How much does AI chatbot development cost in Dubai?

With DigiPromise, ready-built industry agents start from the monthly prices shown on our pricing page, with a one-time setup fee or no setup fee on annual plans. Fully custom chatbots with special integrations are quoted after a short call.

How long does it take to build an AI chatbot?

Our industry agents are ready to build on, so setup starts within 24 hours of your kickoff call. Custom builds with deeper integrations usually take 2 to 4 weeks.

Can the chatbot speak Arabic?

Yes. Every chatbot we build understands and replies in Arabic and English, plus 100+ other languages, and switches automatically to the customer's language.

Which channels can the chatbot work on?

Your website, WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Facebook Messenger and Telegram. Our Stella agent also handles phone calls.

Do I need technical knowledge?

No. We handle the build, training, integrations, testing and ongoing improvements. You just review and approve.

Can the chatbot connect to my CRM?

Yes. We connect to Google Sheets, HubSpot, Zoho and most CRMs through webhooks, so every lead lands where your team works.
